PGRST_DB_URI.name: PGRST_DB_URI
PGRST_DB_URI.description: PostgreSQL connection string for PostgREST. Uses private networking and references postgres service vars.

PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS.name: PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS
PGRST_DB_SCHEMAS.description: Comma-separated list of database schemas PostgREST exposes. graphql_public omitted (requires pg_graphql extension).

PGRST_DB_ANON_ROLE.name: PGRST_DB_ANON_ROLE
PGRST_DB_ANON_ROLE.description: Database role used for anonymous (unauthenticated) requests. Must match the role created in PostgreSQL init scripts.

PGRST_DB_EXTRA_SEARCH_PATH.name: PGRST_DB_EXTRA_SEARCH_PATH
PGRST_DB_EXTRA_SEARCH_PATH.description: Extra schema search path for PostgREST to find functions and types in the public schema.

PGRST_JWT_SECRET.name: PGRST_JWT_SECRET
PGRST_JWT_SECRET.description: HS256 secret for verifying JWTs. References the auth service's JWT_SECRET so all services share the same signing key.

PGRST_SERVER_PORT.name: PGRST_SERVER_PORT
PGRST_SERVER_PORT.description: PostgREST listen port. so health checks and Kong proxy can reach it.
